items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: I never knew Curly personally. Never was introduced.

ctx.x: these lamb heads fresh, and they're going to boil that later in the morning and have this Italian feast. That's a delicacy.

So Curly Russell is in front of me... It's a nice little cabaret. We're on the side in a trunk(?) in the back -- a dive. Me and Bill are playing for this game they've got going back over there. So Curly Russell came and looked... I never knew Curly personally. Never was introduced. I've seen him, rubbed elbows with him, but never to speak to him. He never searched me out and I never searched him out. But he came to the stand, he looked at me, I looked at him. And he looked at Bill, like, in amazement. And I'm…
